dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Good evening ... I need help. Yeah, stupid thing ...
{WHAT'S YOUR NAME?}What is your name sir?
I'm Jacob Copus.
{WHAT HAPPENED?} Why did you call 911?
My cat climbed up a tree and won't come down. It's very dark... could you send firefighters?
{I'LL SEND THE FIREMEN} Ok, I will send the fire department.
{CLIMB THE TREE} Is it a tall tree? Have you tried climbing it and getting the cat down yourself?
It's not really high.... but it's dark ...
{DO IT YOURSELF} Well, you can try climbing the tree yourself if you want to try to get your cat down, but I don't have any fire department vehicles available right now to help you.

dialogOption.emotions: trying to climb a tree, heavy breathing, [heavy drop later]

dialogOption.texten: {WHAT HAPPENED?} Hello? What happened?
I fell off the f..... tree and I think I broke my leg! Why did you tell me to climb there?!
I did not tell you to do anything.
You told me to take that damn cat out of the tree! I will make a complaint! Help, it hurts like hell!
{I'LL SEND AN AMBULANCE} I'm sending you an ambulance, please wait.
{WHERE ARE YOU?} Where are you calling from?
I'm around [[ADDRESS]].
I'm around 1st street 135
I'm around 2nd avenue 246
I'm around Pine street 389
Thank you, I'll be waiting.
Just hurry.... for god's sake, it hurts....
So? Can you help me?
Here... Kitty-kitty...
{I CAN'T HELP YOU} Excuse me sir, we can't help you at the moment.
{NOT AN EMERGENCY} Your matter is not life-threatening, we cannot help you right now.
Thank you...

reportElement.texten: The caller has fallen down the tree and broken his leg.
Cat was taken down from the tree.
A formal complaint about operator's actions was made by the caller.
